> arch_joint/probe_auxiliary.do /Users/jiayuanren/项目规划/.worktrees/codex-v18
> 11-m1/tests/fixtures/arma_garch_joint/auxiliary_v1 /Users/jiayuanren/项目规划
> /.worktrees/codex-v1811-m1/tests/fixtures/arma_garch_joint/oracle_v1 

. // Independent Stata IC, variance-prime, persistence and diagnostic checks.
. version 18

. set more off

. args output source

. cd "`output'"
/Users/jiayuanren/项目规划/.worktrees/codex-v1811-m1/tests/fixtures/arma_garch_
> joint/auxiliary_v1

. foreach case in garch11_constant garch11_zero garch21_constant arch2_constant
>  {
  2.     import delimited using "`source'/data_`case'.csv", asdouble clear case
> (preserve)
  3.     tsset t
  4.     local ar "ar(1)"
  5.     local variance "arch(1) garch(1)"
  6.     local constant ""
  7.     if "`case'" == "garch21_constant" local ar "ar(1/2)"
  8.     if "`case'" == "arch2_constant" local variance "arch(1/2)"
  9.     if "`case'" == "garch11_zero" local constant "noconstant"
 10.     quietly arch y, `ar' ma(1) `variance' `constant' arch0(xb) arma0(zero)
>  vce(opg) tolerance(1e-12) ltolerance(1e-12) nrtolerance(1e-8)
 11.     matrix b = e(b)
 12.     local k = colsof(b)
 13.     quietly estat ic
 14.     matrix ic = r(S)
 15.     predict double residual, residuals
 16.     predict double variance, variance
 17.     generate double squared = residual^2
 18.     quietly summarize squared, meanonly
 19.     scalar prime = r(mean)
 20.     generate double standardized = residual/sqrt(variance)
 21.     generate double squared_standardized = standardized^2
 22.     file open out using auxiliary_`case'.tsv, write replace
 23.     file write out "aic" _tab %24.17g (ic[1,5]) _n
 24.     file write out "bic" _tab %24.17g (ic[1,6]) _n
 25.     file write out "prime" _tab %24.17g (prime) _n
 26.     if "`case'" != "arch2_constant" {
 27.         scalar persistence = b[1,`k'-2]+b[1,`k'-1]
 28.         file write out "persistence" _tab %24.17g (persistence) _n
 29.         file write out "half_life" _tab %24.17g (ln(.5)/ln(persistence)) _
> n
 30.     }
 31.     foreach series in standardized squared_standardized {
 32.         foreach lag in 5 10 20 {
 33.             quietly wntestq `series', lags(`lag')
 34.             file write out "`series'_q`lag'" _tab %24.17g (r(stat)) _n
 35.             file write out "`series'_p`lag'" _tab %24.17g (r(p)) _n
 36.         }
 37.     }
 38.     file close out
 39. }
